releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.51 makes the Home, Files, Notes and Library identity header visually identical with one light translucent background card, consistent spacing and one clean Settings gear. My Places photo actions now offer Take Photo, Choose from Photos and Find Place Photo; the Google option opens a targeted image search using the saved place name and location without scraping. Saved and editor place photos can be tapped for a zoomable full-screen preview, while existing remove/change photo, Near Me, Library/Inbox, Price Photos and Instagram flows stay intact.
